repos.description: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
repos.intro: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. It supports the local Codex App Server and Claude Code , plus Grok CLI , OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor CLI , and Cline CLI through ACP.
features: Prompt-driven agent creation and editing on desktop and mobile, with editable instructions, avatar, and section review before saving.
Persistent agents backed by independent Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, or Cline sessions and local workspaces.
Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and custom ACP agents, with detection of local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio) and installed agents.
Per-agent context monitoring with automatic compaction before long threads exhaust the model window.
FIFO message queues with pause, resume, cancellation, and crash-safe persistence.
Agent-to-agent messages, replies, reactions, images, and managed file transfers.
repos.description_zh: 一個用於持久化 AI 隊友的 local-first 桌上型工作空間。透過專屬工作空間、任務隊列、檔案共享、瀏覽器控制以及 agent-to-agent 協作來執行 Codex、Claude 與 Grok。
repos.intro_zh: OpenBot 是一個用於持久化 AI 隊友的 local-first 桌上型工作空間。它支援 local Codex App Server 與 Claude Code，並透過 ACP 支援 Grok CLI、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor CLI 與 Cline CLI。
features_zh: 在桌上型與行動裝置上進行以 Prompt 為驅動的 agent 建立與編輯，並在儲存前提供可編輯的指令、頭像與區塊審查。
由獨立的 Codex、Claude、Grok、OpenCode、Gemini、Cursor 或 Cline 會話與 local 工作空間所支援的持久化 agents。
自定義 OpenAI 相容的 endpoints 與自定義 ACP agents，並具備對 local model servers (Ollama, LM Studio) 與已安裝 agents 的偵測功能。
針對每個 agent 進行 context 監控，並在長對話耗盡 model window 之前自動進行 compaction。
具備暫停、恢復、取消與 crash-safe 持久化功能的 FIFO 訊息隊列。
Agent-to-agent 訊息、回覆、反應、圖片以及受管理的檔案傳輸。
repos.description_src: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.

repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
repos.intro: Claude-Mem seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions. This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect.
repos.description_zh: 為每個 Agent 提供跨 Session 的持久 Context – 擷取您的 Agent 在 Session 期間所做的一切，透過 AI 進行壓縮，並將相關的 Context 注入未來的 Session 中。支援 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Codex、Gemini、Hermes、Copilot、OpenCode 等更多工具。
repos.intro_zh: Claude-Mem 透過自動擷取工具使用觀察（tool usage observations）、生成語義摘要（semantic summaries），並將其提供給未來的 Session，從而實現跨 Session 的無縫 Context 保留。這讓 Claude 即使在 Session 結束或重新連線後，仍能維持對專案知識的連續性。
repos.description_src: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More

repos.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
repos.intro: The AI assistant your company can actually own. Same shape as ChatGPT, Claude or Grok, with one difference that matters: it runs on your infrastructure and you can change anything about it. Any agent stack, through AG-UI.
features: A computer per person : the supervisor gives each person their own container, with a folder and browser profile for each of their Bots.
A shell, not just a browser : a Bot can run a command in its workspace, install what it needs, and process a file it saved.
The gateway is the only way in : it resolves the target from a server-held snapshot, evaluates the policy, writes the audit row, and only th…
CEL policy, fail closed : rules can inspect tool.name , intent , bot.id , actor.id , page.url , page.host , element.* , key , command , file…
Watch what it is doing : the screen shows what a Bot is looking at, and the Activity tab beside it shows what it ran, read and saved, with t…
Take the wheel : a Bot that hits a login wall or a 2FA prompt asks for help.
repos.description_zh: 開源 AI 同事，每位同事都擁有自己的電腦：包含瀏覽器、檔案與工具，且每一項動作都在發生前決定，並在發生後記錄。支援任何 AG-UI agent。
repos.intro_zh: 貴公司真正可以擁有的 AI 助手。外觀與 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Grok 相同，但有一個關鍵差異：它運行在您的基礎設施上，且您可以更改其任何設定。透過 AG-UI 支援任何 agent stack。
features_zh: 每人一台電腦：管理者為每個人分配專屬的 container，並為其每個 Bot 提供獨立的資料夾與瀏覽器設定檔（browser profile）。
不僅僅是瀏覽器，更是 shell：Bot 可以在其工作空間中執行指令、安裝所需工具，並處理其儲存的檔案。
Gateway 是唯一的進入點：它從伺服器持有的 snapshot 中解析目標、評估 policy、寫入稽核紀錄（audit row），並且僅在……
CEL policy，預設拒絕（fail closed）：規則可以檢查 tool.name、intent、bot.id、actor.id、page.url、page.host、element.*、key、command、file……
監控其行為：螢幕會顯示 Bot 正在查看的內容，旁邊的 Activity 分頁則顯示其執行、讀取與儲存的內容，並附帶……
接管控制權：當 Bot 遇到登入牆或 2FA 提示時，會請求協助。
repos.description_src: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
